MIRROR_PUPIL.title: Kotodama: Mirror Pupil
MIRROR_PUPIL.flavor: What the mirror reflects, the word makes real.
MIRROR_PUPIL.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]100[/blue] stacks of [b]Pupil Mark[/b] and summon a [b]Mirror Image[/b] (if its HP is above 0). The Mirror Image's initial HP and Max HP equal 30% of yours. Each time you play a card, roll 1d100; on a roll ≤ your Pupil Mark stacks: the Mirror Image Summons 1, and if the card is an Attack, it is played again with the Mirror Image as the damage source. Then lose [blue]25[/blue] Pupil Mark (never below 25). Whenever you heal HP, the Mirror Image also heals half that amount (rounded up).
